name: General predatory-fee pack
jurisdiction: Any market. Informed by public FTC junk-fee enforcement patterns
summary: Patterns that inflate the real cost of a rental or storage agreement anywhere: drip-priced mandatory fees, penalty-sized late fees, and lock-in terms.

rules.title: Mandatory fee not in the headline price
rules.note: Required fees that are not part of the advertised price are a classic junk-fee pattern. The FTC has pursued large rental landlords over undisclosed mandatory fees.
rules.ask: Is this fee required? If so, can you include it in the advertised rent so I can compare properly?
rules.source: FTC: Invitation Homes, $48M (2024); Progress Residential / Pretium, $49.75M (November 2026).

rules.title: True monthly cost well above rent
rules.note: Add every required recurring fee to the rent. If the total is far above the quoted rent, compare listings on the total, not the headline.
rules.ask: What is the total I must pay each month, including every required fee?

rules.title: Penalty-sized late fee
rules.note: Late fees far above the landlord's real cost of a late payment act as a penalty. About 5% of rent is a common benchmark.
rules.ask: Can the late fee be capped at about 5% of monthly rent?
rules.green: The late fee is a modest share of rent.

rules.title: No grace period
rules.note: A late fee that applies on the due date leaves no room for bank delays.
rules.ask: Can we add a grace period of a few days before a late fee applies?

rules.title: Automatic renewal lock-in
rules.note: Automatic renewal with a long notice window is a common lock-in pattern in rental and storage agreements.
rules.ask: Can renewal require my written agreement instead of renewing automatically?
rules.green: The agreement does not renew automatically.

rules.title: Long cancellation notice
rules.note: Long notice periods make it easy to miss the window and get charged for another term.
rules.ask: Can the notice period be 30 days?

rules.title: Exit penalty
rules.note: Exit penalties should be predictable and proportionate. Ask for a fixed cap.
rules.ask: What is the maximum I would pay to end early?
